page.title: Routing rules
page.intro: Send cases to the right role and flag them, by report type, legal entity or answer. Rules run in the order shown; the first rule that names an owner wins, flags add up, and the tier only goes up. The conflict-of-interest policy always comes first.
page.emptyBody: Without rules, each case goes to its report type’s own owner role. Add a rule to send some cases elsewhere — for example, every claims-fraud report to the Special Investigation Unit.

list.orderHint: Rules run from top to bottom. Drag a rule, or use its arrows, to change the order.

editor.conditionsIntro: The case must meet every condition that is set. Inside one list, any value matches. Rules don’t need a question on the form.
editor.actionsIntro: What happens to a case that matches.

hints.codePrefixes: For example FRD-CLM matches FRD-CLM-01 and FRD-CLM-02.
hints.noCategories: Your report types have no categories yet. Type one to add it.
hints.reportTypeCodes: Only report types with a code are listed.
hints.noTypeCodes: None of your report types has a code yet.
hints.entityCodes: The legal entity comes from the portal address the reporter used.
hints.noEntities: Your organization has no legal entities.
hints.answersFromTypes_one: Questions from the {{count}} report type these conditions select.
hints.answersFromTypes_other: Questions from the {{count}} report types these conditions select.
hints.answersAllTypes: Questions from all report types. Add a report type condition to narrow the list.
hints.currency: Amounts are compared in normal units: write 500000 for 500,000 SAR. The currency itself isn’t compared.
hints.backupRole: Takes the case when the report names someone in the owner role.
hints.flags: Flags from your jurisdiction pack show their label. You can type another code (letters, digits, _ and -).
hints.raiseTier: Only raises the tier; a case already at a higher tier keeps it.

answers.noQuestions: No questions to match on: the selected report types have none.

errors.name: Enter a name of up to 120 characters.
errors.priority: Enter a whole number from 0 to 100000.
errors.condition: Add at least one condition, so the rule can’t match every case by accident.
errors.action: Add at least one action: an owner role, a backup role, a flag or a tier.

toast.savedWithWarnings_one: Rule saved with {{count}} warning. See it on the rule.
toast.savedWithWarnings_other: Rule saved with {{count}} warnings. See them on the rule.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: Cases already filed keep the routing they got. New cases won’t use this rule.

preview.title: Where would this case go?
preview.intro: Try a report type and sample answers to see which role takes the case, its flags and tier, and who would be assigned. Nothing is saved.
preview.queue: Nobody yet: it waits in the queue
